10395-joy-and-power-three-messages-with-.title: Three messages with One meaning
10395-joy-and-power-three-messages-with-.creator: Henry van Dyke
10395-joy-and-power-three-messages-with-.description: A book by Henry van Dyke. In the wish for happiness all men are strangely alike. In their explanations of it and in their ways of seeking it they are singularly different. Shall we think of this wish as right, or wrong; as a true star, or a will-o'-the-wisp? If it is right to wish to be happy, what are the conditions on which the fulfilment of this wish depends?

arxiv-2009-06864.creator: Published in Harvard Data Science Review
arxiv-2009-06864.description: Abstract Recently, much attention has been focused on the replicability of scientific results, causing scientists, statisticians, and journal editors to examine closely their methodologies and publishing criteria. Experimental particle physicists have been aware of the precursors of non-replicable research for many decades and have many safeguards to ensure that the published results are as reliable as possible.

arxiv-2109-02124.title: The Koha Code A Biological Theory of Memory
arxiv-2109-02124.creator: Lum Ramabaja
arxiv-2109-02124.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lum Ramabaja. This work introduces the Koha model, a new theory that aims to explain two unresolved phenomena within biological neural networks: How information is processed and stored within neural circuits, and how neurons learn to become pattern detectors. In the Koha model, the dendritic spines of a neuron serve as computational units that scan for precise spike patterns in their synaptic inputs.

arxiv-2112-01132.title: A Practical Dynamic Programming Approach to Datalog Provenance Computation
arxiv-2112-01132.creator: Yann Ramusat, Silviu Maniu, Pierre Senellart
arxiv-2112-01132.description: Abstract We establish a translation between a formalism for dynamic programming over hypergraphs and the computation of semiring-based provenance for Datalog programs. The benefit of this translation is a new method for computing provenance for a specific class of semirings. Theoretical and practical optimizations lead to an efficient implementation using Soufflé , a state-of-the-art Datalog interpreter.

arxiv-2208-03594.title: On the L 2 L^{2} well-posedness and decay estimate of third order Benjamin-Ono equation
arxiv-2208-03594.creator: Lizhe Wan
arxiv-2208-03594.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lizhe Wan. We consider the L 2 L^{2} well-posedness of third order Benjamin-Ono equation. We show that by means of a normal form and a gauge transformation, the equation can be changed into an Airy-type equation. A second goal of this work is to establish that the solutions to the nonlinear third order Benjamin-Ono equation problem exhibit a dispersive decay estimate analogue to the corresponding linear associated problem.

arxiv-2301-07125.title: Incoherent transport in a model for the strange metal phase: Memory-matrix formalism
arxiv-2301-07125.creator: Emile Pangburn, Anurag Banerjee, Hermann Freire, Catherine Pépin
arxiv-2301-07125.description: Abstract We revisit a phenomenological model of fermions coupled to fluctuating bosons that emerges from finite-momentum particle-particle pairs for describing the strange metal phase in the cuprates. The incoherent bosons dominate the transport properties for the resistivity and optical conductivity in the non-Fermi liquid phase.

arxiv-2301-13865.title: From Semi-supervised to Omni-supervised Room Layout Estimation Using Point Clouds
arxiv-2301-13865.creator: Huan-ang Gao, Beiwen Tian, Pengfei Li, Xiaoxue Chen, Hao Zhao, Guyue Zhou, Yurong Chen, Hongbin Zha
arxiv-2301-13865.description: Abstract Room layout estimation is a long-existing robotic vision task that benefits both environment sensing and motion planning. However, layout estimation using point clouds (PCs) still suffers from data scarcity due to annotation difficulty. As such, we address the semi-supervised setting of this task based upon the idea of model exponential moving averaging.

arxiv-2411-00876.title: Resilience to the Flowing Unknown: an Open Set Recognition Framework for Data Streams
arxiv-2411-00876.creator: Marcos Barcina-Blanco, Jesus L. Lobo, Pablo Garcia-Bringas, Javier Del Ser
arxiv-2411-00876.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Marcos Barcina-Blanco, Jesus L. Lobo, Pablo Garcia-Bringas, Javier Del Ser. Modern digital applications extensively integrate Artificial Intelligence models into their core systems, offering significant advantages for automated decision-making. However, these AI-based systems encounter reliability and safety challenges when handling continuously generated data streams in complex and dynamic scenarios. This work explores the concept of resilient AI systems, which must operate in the face of unexpected events, including instances that belong to patterns that have not been seen during the training process.

arxiv-2507-06597.title: Majority bootstrap percolation on the permutahedron and other high-dimensional graphs
arxiv-2507-06597.creator: Maurício Collares and Joshua Erde and Anna Geisler and Mihyun Kang
arxiv-2507-06597.description: Abstract . Majority bootstrap percolation is a model of infection spreading in networks. Starting with a set of initially infected vertices, new vertices become infected once half of their neighbours are infected. Balogh, Bollobás and Morris studied this process on the hypercube and showed that there is a phase transition as the density of the initially infected set increases.

pmc-10669059.description: Simple SummaryHuaixiang chicken is a famous local broiler in China. It has excellent meat quality, but its disadvantage is a low laying rate. At present, improving the laying rate of poultry via nutritional regulation has attracted the extensive attention of researchers. Canthaxanthin(CX) is a ketocarotenoid, which widely exists in marine animals, algae, and a few terrestrial plants.

pmc-11439831.creator: Lin Wang, Di Chen, Fangping Tang, Haiyu Liu
pmc-11439831.description: Hydrofoils, as fundamental components of hydraulic machinery, directly influence the performance of such machinery. This study conducted an analysis of the cavitation characteristics of hydrofoils at a + 4° angle of attack under various cavitation numbers using numerical simulation and experimental research methods.

pmc-11461229.title: Galectin-9 – ligand axis: an emerging therapeutic target for multiple myeloma
pmc-11461229.creator: Rajib K. Shil, Norhan B. B. Mohammed, Charles J. Dimitroff
pmc-11461229.description: Galectin-9 (Gal-9) is a tandem-repeat galectin with diverse roles in immune homeostasis, inflammation, malignancy, and autoimmune diseases. In cancer, Gal-9 displays variable expression patterns across different tumor types. Its interactions with multiple binding partners, both intracellularly and extracellularly, influence key cellular processes, including immune cell modulation and tumor microenvironment dynamics.

This is because different genotypes can display important differences in behaviour and physiological tolerances.

pmc-13021887.creator: Xinping Cui, Bin Song, Qian Zhou, Siyu Yang, Yan Zeng
pmc-13021887.description: ObjectiveMaternal hypertension has serious maternal and neonatal consequences. Therefore, we conducted a meta-analysis to evaluate the relationship between maternal hypertension and the risk of cleft lip and palate in offspring.

pmc-13066770.title: Potential of Agricultural Plantations and Orchards to Support Understory Forest Bird Diversity in Southeast Asia
pmc-13066770.creator: Ku Noor Khalidah, Badrul Azhar, Natsuki Komada, Masumi Hisano, Tetsuro Hosaka
pmc-13066770.description: Tropical forests hold two‐thirds of the world's biodiversity but have declined due to forest degradation and deforestation, mainly driven by agricultural expansion. Although agricultural lands, such as plantations and orchards, are matrices (i.e., unsuitable habitats) for many forest species in general, their impact on biodiversity could largely differ depending on the type of agricultural land and management practices.

pmc-13129075.title: Reconstruction of microtia with crus helicis transversal deformity using flap technique combined with ear cartilage transplantation: a retrospective study
pmc-13129075.creator: Yiwen Deng, Hongli Zhao, Jianguo Chen, Zexin Zhang, Peixu Wang, Senmao Wang, Wenkang Luan, Xiaobo Yu, Lin Lin, Bo Pan, Haiyue Jiang
pmc-13129075.description: BackgroundThe combination of crus helicis transverse deformity and microtia presents one of the most complex ear deformities. Historically, the surgical correction of this deformity has predominantly utilized rib cartilage for ear reconstruction. This study presents a method for correcting microtia with crus helicis transversal deformity, utilizing the flap technique in conjunction with cartilage transplantation.
